the Israeli military in six languages (es/en/bn/fr). Exactly the cross-language institution merge the pipeline exists to make.

four collective Taliban entities ('Afghan Taliban', 'Taliban authorities', 'Taliban officials', 'Taliban provincial officials') into the Deputy Spokesman. Institution<->spokesperson is the pipeline's own convention, but a government is not its spokesman and 'provincial officials' is a different scope again. Counted neither way below.

four spellings of the Romanian Ministry of Defence merged into the Defence Minister — the institution<->office-holder merge the corpus makes routinely and which the detector accepts elsewhere via role_link.
'Greece' (Greek government) merged with the Spanish government, AEMET (Spanish met agency) and Spain's Guardia Civil into a generic 'Authorities'. Two different countries in one actor.
four transliterations of Abbas Araghchi, Iran's FOREIGN minister, merged into 'Iranian military officials'. The four spellings are one person and merging them is right; the TARGET is wrong.
IRGC in four languages, one of them carrying the Persian name as a gloss. Legitimate.
'Port Director of al-Makha' is a different person from the Houthi military spokesperson. The two Houthi-group aliases alongside it are defensible; the port director is not.
